basics.name: clusterName
basics.label: AKS Cluster Name
basics.toolTip: Specify a unique name for the Azure Kubernetes Service cluster (3-63 lowercase alphanumeric characters or hyphens).

constraints.validationMessage: The cluster name must be between 3 and 63 characters long, start and end with an alphanumeric character, and contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

options.text: Configure the Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) cluster for Neo4j Enterprise Edition.

elements.name: kubernetesVersion
elements.label: Kubernetes Version
elements.toolTip: Select the Kubernetes version for the AKS cluster control plane and nodes.

elements.name: nodeVmSize
elements.label: Worker Node VM Size
elements.toolTip: Choose the VM size for the AKS worker nodes. Standard_D4s_v5 or higher recommended for Enterprise workloads.

elements.name: nodeCount
elements.label: Worker Node Count
elements.toolTip: Number of worker nodes in the initial system agent pool (minimum 3 required for a 3-member cluster).

elements.name: osDiskSizeGB
elements.label: OS Disk Size (GB)
elements.toolTip: Operating system disk size in GB for each AKS node.

constraints.validationMessage: Please provide a valid disk size in GB between 30 and 2048.

options.text: The Neo4j Kubernetes Operator automates lifecycle management and high-availability operations for Neo4j Enterprise clusters on AKS.

elements.name: operatorVersion
elements.label: Operator Release Version
elements.toolTip: Target version of the Neo4j Kubernetes Operator Helm chart from ghcr.io/neo4j-partners/charts/neo4j-operator.

constraints.validationMessage: Please specify a valid semver version (e.g. 1.0.0).

elements.name: operatorNamespace
elements.label: Operator Namespace
elements.toolTip: The Kubernetes namespace where the operator controller will be installed.

constraints.validationMessage: Must be a valid Kubernetes namespace name.

elements.name: deployDatabaseInstance
elements.label: Deploy Neo4j Enterprise Instance
elements.toolTip: Provision an initial Neo4j Enterprise database cluster upon AKS deployment.

elements.name: databaseInstanceName
elements.label: Database Instance Name
elements.toolTip: Name of the Neo4j Custom Resource.

constraints.validationMessage: Must be a valid Kubernetes resource name.

elements.name: acceptLicense
elements.label: I accept the Neo4j Enterprise Edition License Agreement

elements.name: neo4jVersion
elements.label: Neo4j Enterprise Version
elements.toolTip: Neo4j Enterprise Server version to run.

elements.name: topologyMode
elements.label: Topology Mode
elements.toolTip: Cluster provides high-availability multi-core Raft clustering; Standalone runs 1 enterprise instance.

elements.name: clusterCoreCount
elements.label: Cluster Core Servers
elements.toolTip: Number of core servers in the cluster (typically 3 or 5).

elements.name: storageSize
elements.label: Data Volume Size
elements.toolTip: Disk volume size for database files (e.g. 50Gi, 200Gi).

constraints.validationMessage: Please specify a size followed by Gi or Ti (e.g., 50Gi).

elements.name: neo4jPassword
elements.toolTip: If left blank, the operator generates a random secret. If provided, must meet Azure complexity requirements.

elements.name: serviceType
elements.label: Service Connectivity
elements.toolTip: LoadBalancer creates an Azure Public Load Balancer; ClusterIP keeps the service internal to the cluster.
